title: Tar balls on Goa beaches traced to an offshore oil rig
subRegion: Goa beaches, Arabian Sea (source offshore, unidentified at time of deposition)

oil.spilledNote: Weathered crude residues (tar balls). NIO multi-marker fingerprinting matched an offshore oil rig.

officialFindings: Chemical fingerprinting matched May 2017 Goa tar balls to an offshore oil rig. No vessel identified.
